verdict.rationale: The API reference and guides live under a versioned /docs/v3/ path, which implies a versioned API. A public changelog notes backward-compatible, opt-in changes ("off by default so today's behaviour is unchanged"), and the CLI promises stable error codes. There is no documented deprecation policy, and the evidence only implies explicit API versioning semantics rather than stating them. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices), explicit API versioning semantics (version headers/paths, support windows), and independent corroboration of version stability.
